name: Amber Enterprises India Limited
summary: Amber Enterprises India Limited engages in the room air conditioners (RAC) industry in India. It offers complete built units and various components for consumer durable goods; room air conditioners, such as split AC, outdoor unit, window AC, and top-throw window AC; and commercial air conditioners, including cassette AC, tower AC, duct, VRF, water heat pump, and outdoor unit.
